default.description: Capabilities for the main PDFedits window: native open/save dialogs and reading/writing the files the user picks. Scope is intentionally broad ('**' = anywhere) — this is a single-user offline desktop app, the only files it ever touches are ones the person explicitly picked via a native file dialog, and narrower per-folder scoping (Documents/Downloads/Home only) was the suspected cause of 'Couldn't open project file' errors when a .pdfedits file lived somewhere else, e.g. a synced or external drive.
